message.content:
This editorial illustration shows the top half of a person's head and their right hand appearing over a white rectangular sheet, which mimics a magazine cover. The person has tan skin and dark hair. Only their forehead, eyes, nose, and top of the cheeks are visible. Their hand grips the top right edge of the white sheet, with the fingers curled over the front.

The white sheet is bordered by a vertical red band on the left. The word "TEMPO" is printed in large red serif letters across the center. Above this, a line of grey text reads "SUBSIDI BIMBANG YUDHOYONO". Below the title, smaller black text reads "EDISI 6-12 MEI 2013". The center of the sheet features the words "PARODI SUSNO DUADJI" in large, bold black sans-serif font, stacked vertically.

The bottom left corner contains small black text including "RP 33.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126-4273". A barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00010" is located below the text. The background behind the person is black.
